evidence_type: Maintainer implementation inspection and public artifact check
scope: TalkOrigins modernization workflow, bibliography maintenance, translation queue, and local model integration

observations.observed: Modernization preserves attributed legacy bodies and separates generated study additions; scoped updates avoid rebuilding unrelated output.
observations.basis: TalkOrigins Modern README and scoped update workflow

observations.observed: CiteGeist topic data is rendered as HTML and BibTeX; new pages enter four-language translation work orders; bibliography index changes can use fragment deltas.
observations.basis: Maintainer bibliography render/queue helpers and CiteGeist worked example

observations.observed: Terminology compendium, grouped chunking, node probes, per-unit leases, run manifests, retry and stale-lease recovery.
observations.basis: Translation runner and resilient queue documentation

observations.observed: Local translation is the configured default; a capped alternate-provider path covers selected routes and prior errors or warnings.
Inspected worker configuration selects Qwen3.5-9B for Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese; local hosting uses llama.cpp-based services.
observations.basis: Worker configuration and local endpoint launch documentation

observations.observed: GenieHive provides registration and routing; model runtimes own inference and process lifecycle. The queue also supports directly addressed compatible endpoints.
observations.basis: Public GenieHive README and translation guide; TalkOrigins worker configuration

public_translation_snapshot.interpretation: Recorded generation coverage, not expert-review status or a current inventory of all Archive content.

limits: No live worker availability, cost savings, speedup, or expert-reviewed translation rate is claimed.
Private source records, addresses, credentials, and host inventory are omitted.
The public queue snapshot is dated; later source changes require new work.
